page.overview:
What is Anvil?

Anvil was a neighborhood of Ravens Bluff's Crow's End district and the very epicenter of activity surrounding the city's inner harbor, Clearwater Harbor, due in large part to being where the government's central customs office was located. Any goods brought into the city with the intent of staying had to go through here for inspection, packing, and labeling. This made Anvil the veritable "heart and soul" of the economic business that kept Ravens Bluff alive, as well as a neighborhood where every criminal group, shipping concern, and merchant house desired to have a presence and influence over.

The name of the neighborhood was popularly associated with a Ravenian saying that dated back to the days of Sarbreen. It was said to be the place "where the hammer comes down", with some saying so with an unspoken implication that the phrase continued on as, "and only the strong survive."

Anvil was composed of around twenty-two or so city blocks and hosted five docks. At its eastern end the neighborhood butted the DeVillars Creek, until terminating along Omphrel's Span, the creek's most downstream bridge. From the west it was bordered by the neighborhood of Bitterstone, which it shared nine streets with, with Blacktree Boulevard South running along their boundary line. To the north it was bordered by Altarside, which it shared seven streets with, with Morlgar's Ride running along their boundary line.

Anvil's buildings sported the most architectural variety out of anywhere in the city. And nowhere else could one find as profuse a collection of people of different races, backgrounds, and social classes rubbing shoulders. Anvil was also popular amongst most adventurers as a place to find drink and company.
